summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of selective laser melting processing parameters on the microstructure and properties of TiC/H13 steel bulk-form nanocomposites.
summary_en.method: Varying laser power and scanning speed during SLM to fabricate nanocomposite samples.
summary_en.result: High-density bulk nanocomposites with improved hardness and compressive strength were achieved under optimized parameters.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization (SEM, XRD) and mechanical testing (hardness, compression) were performed.

papers.title: PROCESSING OF NEARLY PURE IRON USING 400W SELECTIVE LASER MELTING – INITIAL STUDY
papers.abstract: Efficient machining using wire electrical discharge machining (WEDM) technology is a compromise between cutting speed and resulting surface quality.Typical morphology of the surface machined by WEDM shows a plenty of craters caused by electrospark discharges produced during the cutting process.This work is focused on assessing the impact of machine setting parameters on quantitative and qualitative evaluation of the workpiece surface of aluminium alloy AlZn6Mg2Cu.Using metallography, the surface effects arisen during the process of wire spark erosion on cross-sections of preparations were studied.Using local spot EDX microanalysis, the chemical composition of the surfaces of the samples was studied.The attention was also paid to the highest height of profile of the craters, which were studied using 3D filtered images.

summary_en.motivation: To optimize wire electrical discharge machining parameters for improved surface quality of aluminum alloy AlZn6Mg2Cu.
summary_en.method: Experimental study investigating the effects of machine settings on surface morphology and chemical composition using metallography and EDX.
summary_en.result: Crater height and surface chemical changes were characterized, linking parameters to surface integrity.
summary_en.validation: Metallographic cross-sections and 3D filtered surface images validated the qualitative and quantitative assessments.

papers.title: Modeling of Processing-Induced Pore Morphology in an Additively-Manufactured Ti-6Al-4V Alloy
papers.abstract: A selective laser melting (SLM)-based, additively-manufactured Ti-6Al-4V alloy is prone to the accumulation of undesirable defects during layer-by-layer material build-up. Defects in the form of complex-shaped pores are one of the critical issues that need to be considered during the processing of this alloy. Depending on the process parameters, pores with concave or convex boundaries may occur. To exploit the full potential of additively-manufactured Ti-6Al-4V, the interdependency between the process parameters, pore morphology, and resultant mechanical properties, needs to be understood. By incorporating morphological details into numerical models for micromechanical analyses, an in-depth understanding of how these pores interact with the Ti-6Al-4V microstructure can be gained. However, available models for pore analysis lack a realistic description of both the Ti-6Al-4V grain microstructure, and the pore geometry. To overcome this, we propose a comprehensive approach for modeling and discretizing pores with complex geometry, situated in a polycrystalline microstructure. In this approach, the polycrystalline microstructure is modeled by means of Voronoi tessellations, and the complex pore geometry is approximated by strategically combining overlapping spheres of varied sizes. The proposed approach provides an elegant way to model the microstructure of SLM-processed Ti-6Al-4V containing pores or crack-like voids, and makes it possible to investigate the relationship between process parameters, pore morphology, and resultant mechanical properties in a finite-element-based simulation framework.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及SLM Ti-6Al-4V孔隙建模，但与生物医学植入物的应力遮挡、疲劳性能或实验验证无关。
llm.why_not_core: No experimental validation, no biomedical implant context, no stress shielding or mechanical testing, and no patient-specific or osseointegration aspects.

summary_zh.motivation: SLM加工Ti-6Al-4V合金易产生复杂孔隙，需理解工艺参数与孔隙形态的关系。
summary_zh.method: 结合Voronoi多晶微观结构和重叠球体近似孔隙几何进行建模。
summary_zh.result: 实现了含孔隙微观结构的参数化建模，可用于有限元模拟分析。
summary_zh.validation: 仅数值建模，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To model complex pore morphology in SLM-processed Ti-6Al-4V for understanding process-microstructure-property relationships.
summary_en.method: Combined Voronoi tessellation for polycrystalline microstructure and overlapping spheres for pore geometry approximation.
summary_en.result: Provided a parametric modeling framework to generate realistic microstructures with pores for finite-element simulations.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; purely numerical modeling approach.
